# Linear design tokens

<!-- Generated by apps/saturn-tauri/scripts/build-token-docs.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Semantic tokens come from `linear-theme.css`, `01-editor.css`, and `00-tokens-glass.css`.
Contrast pairs are enforced by `pnpm check:contrast` at WCAG AA (4.5:1 text on cards/surfaces).

## Surface invariant

- Solid matte surfaces across both themes; zero frosted blur, zero translucent surface fills, zero glow.
- Dark theme cards use `1px` borders with `box-shadow: none`; light theme cards use hairline `0 1px 2px rgb(16 24 40 / 5%)`.
- Motion uses `150ms ease-out`; `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` collapses durations to `0ms linear`.
